description: TodoApp - Full-stack todo list with React + Express, in-memory state, full CRUD surface, starring, age-based guilt-tripping, and a tombstone graveyard for abandoned todos.

userStories.title: Monorepo scaffold with Express health endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the monorepo structure and a running Express server so subsequent stories have a backend to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Root package.json defines npm workspaces for server/ and client/
server/ has TypeScript configured (tsconfig.json) and Express installed
Express server listens on port 3000
GET /api/health returns 200 with JSON body { ok: true }
npm run dev or equivalent starts the server successfully
Typecheck passes (tsc --noEmit in server/)

userStories.title: Vite + React client with API proxy
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the client dev server running with a proxy to Express so the UI can call the API without CORS issues.
acceptanceCriteria: client/ has Vite + React + TypeScript configured
Vite dev server runs on port 5173
Vite config proxies /api/* to http://localhost:3000
Root App component renders a visible heading (e.g. 'TodoApp')
Client successfully reaches /api/health through the proxy
Typecheck passes (tsc --noEmit in client/)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: In-memory todo store and REST API with graveyard
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the full CRUD API (plus the graveyard endpoint) so the client has everything it needs to render and mutate todos.
acceptanceCriteria: In-memory store holds Todo { id, title, completed, starred, createdAt }
GET /api/todos returns 200 with Todo[]
POST /api/todos validates non-empty trimmed title, returns 201 with created Todo; returns 400 on empty/missing title
PATCH /api/todos/:id accepts { completed?, starred? } and returns 200 with updated Todo; returns 404 if id unknown
DELETE /api/todos/:id returns 204; returns 404 if id unknown
Deleting an incomplete todo creates a Tombstone { id, title, abandonedAt } in the graveyard; deleting an already-completed todo does not
GET /api/graveyard returns 200 with Tombstone[]
createdAt is set server-side at creation and never mutated
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Todo list UI - core CRUD
userStories.description: As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete todos from the web UI wired to the API.
acceptanceCriteria: On mount, App fetches GET /api/todos and renders the list
Input + Add button posts a new todo via POST /api/todos; empty submissions are blocked client-side
Each row shows the title with a checkbox that toggles completed via PATCH /api/todos/:id
Each row has a delete button that calls DELETE /api/todos/:id and removes the row on success
UI re-renders from server responses (no optimistic updates required)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Starring, sorting, age labels, neglected styling, and graveyard section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to star todos to pin them, see how long they have been hanging around, and peek at my abandoned todos.
acceptanceCriteria: Each row has a star button: filled (star) when starred is true, outlined when false; click toggles via PATCH
Starred todos always render above non-starred todos regardless of creation order
Incomplete todos display a relative age label next to the title (e.g. '. 2d', '. 3h'); completed todos show no age
Incomplete todos with age >= 3 days render the age label in a distinct muted-red style
A collapsible section labeled 'Abandoned (N)' sits below the main list; N reflects current tombstone count
Expanding the section shows each tombstone with strike-through title and relative abandoned timestamp (e.g. '. abandoned 2h ago')
The count updates after each incomplete-todo deletion
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: API integration tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want integration tests covering the CRUD surface so regressions are caught by the verifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests run against a real Express app instance (e.g. supertest)
Tests cover GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE happy paths on /api/todos
Test verifies POST returns 400 when title is empty or whitespace-only
Test verifies PATCH toggles starred and completed independently
Test verifies deleting an incomplete todo adds a tombstone to /api/graveyard
Test verifies deleting an already-completed todo leaves the graveyard unchanged
npm test from the repo root runs all tests green
Typecheck passes
